description.value: Grizz Hotel is a centrally located hotel in downtown Revelstoke, within walking distance of the Revelstoke Aquatic Centre, museums, and Grizzly Plaza. The hotel features an in-house pub, The Last Drop, with 14 beers on tap, live entertainment, and daily specials. A free shuttle runs to Revelstoke Mountain Resort during winter, and the property is undergoing room renovations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address, phone, and website URL. The amenities page explicitly lists free Wi-Fi and an in-house pub ('The Last Drop'), but makes no mention of bike storage, laundry, drying areas, or any cycling-specific facilities. The note 'Newly renovated rooms coming soon' suggests the property is active and open.
concerns: Website notes 'Newly renovated rooms coming soon' — some rooms may be out of service during renovations.
Website lists an additional toll-free number (1-800-991-4455) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active hotel in downtown Revelstoke with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. Useful to touring cyclists as central accommodation in a major cycling destination.

Nearby evening food.detail: In-house pub 'The Last Drop' offers 14 beers on tap, wine, bottled drinks, non-alcoholic beverages, daily specials, and live entertainment
